scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:fixtures && npm run build:experiments
scripts.check: npm run build && concurrently --success all --names packages,workspace "npm run check:packages" "npm run check:workspace"
scripts.check:workspace: concurrently --success all --names imports,experiments,suppressions,declarations,fixtures,wiring "npm run check:imports" "npm run check:experiments" "npm run check:suppressions" "npm run check:declarations" "npm run check:fixtures" "npm run check:wiring"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:tooling && npm run test --workspaces && npm run test:experiments
scripts.test:experiments: tsd --typings experiments/exp-1/src/protocol.ts --files experiments/exp-1/test-d/protocol.test-d.ts && node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config experiments/exp-1/jest.config.mjs --runInBand && npm run test:exp2 && npm run test:exp3 && npm run test:exp-nested
scripts.check:experiments: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p experiments/exp-1/tsconfig.portable.json && tsc -p experiments/exp-2/tsconfig.portable.json && tsc --noEmit -p experiments/exp-3/tsconfig.portable.json && tsc --noEmit -p experiments/exp-nested/tsconfig.portable.json && eslint experiments --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @microdelta/machine && npm run build --workspace @microdelta/value && npm run build --workspace @microdelta/machine-node && npm run build --workspace @microdelta/definition && npm run build --workspace @microdelta/tracking && npm run build --workspace @microdelta/history && npm run build --workspace @microdelta/materialization && npm run build --workspace @microdelta/resolution && npm run build --workspace microdelta
scripts.build:fixtures: tsc -p fixtures/declarations/producer/tsconfig.json && api-extractor run --config fixtures/declarations/producer/api-extractor.json && tsc -p fixtures/declarations/capture-producer/tsconfig.json && api-extractor run --config fixtures/declarations/capture-producer/api-extractor.json && node tooling/trim-declaration-imports.mjs fixtures/declarations/capture-producer/dist/api/capture.untrimmed.d.ts fixtures/declarations/capture-producer/dist/api/capture.alpha.d.ts fixtures/declarations/capture-producer/dist/api/capture.beta.d.ts fixtures/declarations/capture-producer/dist/api/capture.public.d.ts && tsc -p fixtures/declarations/forged/tsconfig.json && api-extractor run --config fixtures/declarations/forged/api-extractor.json
scripts.check:fixtures: tsc --noEmit -p fixtures/declarations/producer/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p fixtures/declarations/capture-producer/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p fixtures/declarations/forged/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p fixtures/declarations/consumer-alpha/tsconfig.json && node tooling/check-capture-public-tier.mjs && eslint fixtures/declarations/producer/src fixtures/declarations/capture-producer/src fixtures/declarations/forged/src fixtures/declarations/consumer-alpha/src
scripts.test:exp3: tsc -p experiments/exp-3/tsconfig.test.json && node --experimental-vm-modules ./node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config experiments/exp-3/jest.config.mjs --runInBand --runTestsByPath .test-build/experiments/exp-3/test/sqlite-capability.test.js && node --experimental-vm-modules ./node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config experiments/exp-3/jest.config.mjs --runInBand --runTestsByPath .test-build/experiments/exp-3/test/publication.test.js
